pretreatments.description: Chemical treatment using dilute citric acid solution with variables: temperature from 120 to 180 °C, reaction time from 20 to 90 min, and percentage by weight of citric acid (PCA) to sugarcane bagasse from 3 to 12 wt%.
Thermal treatment during the dilute citric acid pretreatment process with temperatures ranging from 120 to 180 °C.
Mechanical degradation through pressing in a hydraulic press at 9 tons to separate solid and liquid fractions after pretreatment.
Enzymatic hydrolysis using Cellic® CTec 3 HS cocktail (containing AA9 molecules, T. reesei cellulases, β-glucosidases, and hemicellulases) at 45–50 °C and pH 5.0–5.5 for 72 h.
